execution.minute_worker: GitHub Actions 5-minute transport wake with four one-minute bounded ticks; no hour-long concurrency queue
execution.durable_handoff: GitHub every 5 minutes plus push triggers
execution.decision_engine_requirement: Invoke reasoning only when claimed work requires judgment; do not require gratuitous model inference on idle minute ticks.
execution.claim_semantics: Every actionable signal becomes a durable READY claim. A claim may close only with an attributable action/terminal receipt; otherwise it remains/reappears READY on subsequent minute ticks.
execution.no_stagnation: Detection/routing is not completion. READY work must remain visible until action receipt or irreducible governed gate.

decision_runtime.title: iSCOPE → PRI Execution Engine
decision_runtime.note: Automation is configured as reasoning surface. Configuration/schedule is not execution proof; acceptance requires a new attributable post-correction run receipt meeting the V2 acceptance gate.

truth_controls: EXECUTING requires a real continuing executor/heartbeat
realized revenue is zero until payment evidence exists
READY claim != commercial action; state-only minute transport cannot satisfy persistent decision runtime acceptance
provider/session/plan loss changes executor availability, not mandate
hourly scheduler wake != business throughput ceiling
acceptance: real opportunity discovered/qualified by iSCOPE with receipt
real inbound response progressed and externally acted on by PRI with receipt
actionable work persists as a durable claim until receipt
no hour-long scheduler backlog prevents fresh pickup

current_evidence.truth: SCHEDULER_WOKE / POST-CORRECTION MATERIAL EXECUTION NOT PROVEN

protected_transport.rule: Existing OVERDRIVE state/claims/receipts/dedupe/routing/minute freshness transport remains intact. Reasoning-layer fixes occur above it.

authoritative_inputs.rule: Read current durable state first. Full opportunity ledger is inventory authority; signals/claims are routing subsets and never an inventory ceiling.

required_paths: CAPABILITY -> NEW APPLICATION -> POSSIBLE PAYER -> EVIDENCED DEMAND -> OPP-ID
MARKET SIGNAL -> REQUIRED OUTCOME -> CAPABILITY MATCH/COMBINATION -> EVIDENCED DELIVERABLE -> OPP-ID
OBSERVED ORGANIZATION PROBLEM -> AMX SOLUTION/RESULT -> CREDIBLE BUYER -> DIRECT-SALE OPP-ID
commercial_reasoning.owner_suggestion_semantics: Owner input is evidence/input, not required discovery trigger or territory definition.

throughput.scheduler_wake: hourly reasoning wake where platform scheduler is used
throughput.business_semantics: wake/resume opportunity only; never one-opportunity-per-wake/tick/minute pacing
throughput.iSCOPE_floor: inspect >=20 candidates across >=4 materially different categories/surfaces unless evidenced supply is smaller; attempt >=1 capability/problem-derived path; no forced qualification quota
throughput.PRI_floor: classify full relevant ledger and materially act on >=5 executable qualified opportunities or ALL if fewer; five is floor not cap

inventory_semantics.current_observed_gap_at_hardening: 13 ledger records vs 4 routed claims/signals at 2026-10-01T17:34:27Z
inventory_semantics.rule: Do not infer the other ledger records are closed/irrelevant merely because they are absent from current routing subsets. Reconcile due/relevant state before acting.

payment_semantics.rule: Missing rail detail triggers authoritative recovery/routing; it does not prove AMX has no compatible rail.
payment_semantics.secret_control: no private keys/seed/recovery material/credentials in durable commercial state

provider_continuity.rule: Loss of ChatGPT session/provider/Plus access changes executor availability only. Preserve mandate, ONE PRI ownership, iSCOPE ownership, opportunities and receipts.
provider_continuity.unavailable_executor_action: Master Control restores/substitutes/reassigns authorized reasoning capability; do not wait for Owner restatement and do not reopen completed conveyor.

required: full opportunities ledger classified rather than only signals/claims
iSCOPE candidate inspection/category coverage evidenced or exact exhaustion evidenced
at least one capability-derived or problem-derived discovery attempt evidenced
PRI material actions effected on executable inventory to floor or exact WAITING/HOLD/terminal reasons evidenced
consequential writes persisted and read back
payment-rail compatibility evaluated without treating a partial inventory as exhaustive
no duplicate outreach, false state advancement, pay-to-work drift, or invented capability/payment
acceptance_v2.rule: Historical Cherry One/LAVDM receipts prove prior capability only; they do not satisfy this post-correction autonomy acceptance gate.
acceptance_v2.latest_observation: A scheduler wake occurred after the initial capability-floor correction, but no new attributable material receipt/state transition was recovered. Do not promote to EXECUTING/RELIABLY_AUTONOMOUS.
